title: The Pilgrim Ghost
text: The ghost of a pilgrim walks beside you, grey and threadbare, a staff in its faded hand. It died on this road long ago and does not know it. Every few steps it asks, politely, how far it is to the shrine.

options.label: Tell it the truth; it deserves to know it died here.

outcomes.text: It weeps without a sound and walks on. It does not ask again.

options.label: Tell it the shrine is not far, and let it go believing.

outcomes.text: It smiles and fades, at peace. For a lie, it sits lightly.

options.label: The devout leads it all the way to the shrine, so its pilgrimage is finished at last.

outcomes.text: At the shrine it blesses them and is gone. The blessing settles on them like a cloak.
